title.narrative: GPE System Capacity Grant Programme for Balochistan Education Sector

description.narrative: The System Capacity Grant (SCG) programme, funded by the Global Partnership for Education (GPE) and implemented by UNESCO, focuses on strengthening educational systems in Balochistan, Pakistan. With an allocation of $1.331 million, the programme aims to improve access and quality of Early Childhood Education (ECE) and primary education through capacity building, gender-responsive policy development, integrated monitoring frameworks, and enhanced sector coordination, aligned with the Balochistan Partnership Compact (2024–2028) to foster sustainable educational transformation and improved learning outcomes by 2028.
